seo.title: Wix: AI creation (Harmony + Base44) at the heart of the free-to-paid funnel - better conversion and ARPU, Base44 at 100M dollars ARR (2025)
seo.meta_description: Wix embeds AI creation (Wix Harmony) in its free-to-paid funnel: first cohorts with better conversion and ARPU. Base44 goes from 59M to 100M dollars ARR.
seo.resume_citable: Wix embedded AI creation in its own free-to-paid funnel: on the Q4/FY2025 earnings call, management ties better conversion, faster monetization, and higher ARPU to the first Wix Harmony cohorts, while the app-creation platform Base44 (acquired in 2025) goes from about 59M to about 100M dollars in ARR and attracts nearly two-thirds of new Wix.com users, on 2025 bookings of 2.07 billion dollars (+13%).

faq.q: How does Wix use AI to convert its users?
faq.a: Wix puts AI creation at the heart of its journey: with Wix Harmony, a user describes their project in natural language and the AI generates the site. Management ties better free-to-paid conversion, faster monetization, and higher ARPU to the first Harmony cohorts.

faq.q: What is Base44 and what are its figures?
faq.a: Base44 is an application-software creation platform driven by prompts (vibe-coding) acquired by Wix in 2025. Its ARR went from about 59 million dollars at year-end to about 100 million shortly after, and it attracts nearly two-thirds of the number of new Wix.com users.

faq.q: What is the evidence level of this case?
faq.a: Level A: the rollout and its impact on conversion, monetization, and ARPU are stated by management on the Q4 and full year 2025 earnings call and echoed in the official release, with consistent financial figures across several sources.

pattern: genAI product creation (site, application) embedded in the freemium funnel to accelerate free-to-paid conversion and raise the ARPU of new cohorts
objectif_business: Convert Wix's free sign-ups into paying customers faster and at higher value, by putting AI site and app creation at the heart of the journey. Two intended effects: improve free-to-paid conversion and cohort ARPU on the legacy Wix.com platform via Harmony, and widen the addressable market to application software via Base44.
description: Wix embeds AI creation directly into its own acquisition and monetization journey. With Wix Harmony, a new user describes their project in natural language and the AI generates the site; the feature launched in English in January 2026, then extended to other languages. In parallel, Base44, an application-software creation platform driven by prompts and acquired in 2025, lets users build no-code applications from natural language instructions. On the fourth quarter and full year 2025 earnings call (March 2026), management ties better free-to-paid conversion, faster monetization, and higher ARPU to the first Harmony cohorts, and describes an acceleration in cohort bookings growth for the core Wix.com business compared with the prior year. Base44 went from about 59 million dollars in ARR at year-end to about 100 million shortly after, one year after its creation and nine months after the acquisition, and attracts nearly two-thirds of the number of new Wix.com users. For full year 2025, total bookings reach 2.07 billion dollars, up 13 percent. The case is about monetizing Wix's own user base: here AI is not a product sold to third parties but the lever that converts free sign-ups into paying customers and raises their value.
points_cles: Wix puts AI creation (Wix Harmony) at the heart of its free-to-paid funnel; the first cohorts show better conversion, faster monetization, and higher ARPU.
Base44, an app-creation-by-prompt platform acquired in 2025, goes from about 59M dollars to about 100M dollars in ARR in a few months.
New Base44 users represent nearly two-thirds of new Wix.com users.
Figures and impact reported in the Q4/FY2025 earnings call and official release (bookings 2.07 billion dollars, +13%).

niveau_preuve.justification: The rollout and its impact on free-to-paid conversion, monetization, and ARPU are stated by Wix's executives (CEO Avishai Abrahami, CFO Lior Shemesh, President Nir Zohar) on the fourth quarter and full year 2025 earnings call, and echoed in the official results release. The hard figures (bookings 2.07 billion dollars up 13 percent, Base44 ARR from about 59M to about 100M dollars, new Base44 users nearly two-thirds of those of Wix.com) are primary financial data, consistent between the official release and two earnings call transcripts. Harmony's conversion/ARPU impact is attributed qualitatively by management (no precise percentage), but the source is indeed an earnings call and a results release.

stack_technique.detail: Wix's AI site editor. The user describes their project in natural language and Harmony generates the site. Launched in English in January 2026, expanding to other languages. Wix ties better conversion, faster monetization, and higher ARPU to its first Harmony cohorts.

An application-software creation platform driven by prompts (vibe-coding), acquired by Wix in 2025. About 59M dollars in ARR at year-end 2025, about 100M dollars shortly after, that is one year after its creation and nine months after the acquisition. New Base44 users represent nearly two-thirds of new Wix.com users.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real time and self-serve: site generation (Harmony) or app generation (Base44) happens on the user's request, and free-to-paid conversion plays out over the course of their journey, with no manual intervention.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Wix's product and growth teams, who own the acquisition funnel, the AI generation, and cohort tracking.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: Free-to-paid conversion and ARPU by cohort. These are the signals the company judges the Harmony cohorts' performance on; if the AI degrades the quality of the generated sites or the onboarding experience, these cohort metrics degrade first.

etapes.detail: A new user creates a free account on Wix.com or Base44.
The user describes their need in natural language; Wix Harmony generates a site, or Base44 generates an application from prompts.
The generated product is published or put online, and the move to a paid plan is offered at the moment the user has the most value at stake.
The growth teams measure free-to-paid conversion, monetization speed, and ARPU of the cohorts from Harmony, and compare with the prior year.
Harmony is extended to new languages and markets; Base44 keeps attracting new users and growing ARR.

prerequis_data: A freemium user base with cohort tracking (sign-up, activation, move to paid)
Product usage signals usable to measure free-to-paid conversion and ARPU by cohort
A corpus/templates and design rules that let a generative model produce a publishable, quality deliverable
prerequis_orga: A product/growth team that owns the funnel end to end
The ability to embed a generative model in onboarding without breaking the perceived quality of the product
A compliance framework (AI transparency, GDPR in an EU environment) for the use of usage data
stack_possible: A generative LLM (built in-house or acquisition of a generation platform, like Base44 at Wix)
A generation engine suited to the deliverable (site, application, content) connected to the product editor
A cohort analytics component to steer conversion and ARPU
The existing freemium funnel as the integration surface
replication.premiere_etape: Finely instrument the free-to-paid funnel by cohort (conversion, monetization speed, ARPU) before connecting AI generation to it, so you can isolate the effect of the AI-exposed cohorts and decide on its extension.

playbook.action: Set up cohort tracking of the freemium funnel measuring free-to-paid conversion, monetization speed, and ARPU.
playbook.livrable: A cohort dashboard serving as a before/after reference.

playbook.action: Embed an AI generation component in onboarding, where the user describes their need in natural language and gets a usable deliverable.
playbook.livrable: AI creation journey in production on a first language/market.

playbook.action: Compare the AI-exposed cohorts with the historical cohorts on conversion and ARPU, and fix the quality of the generated deliverable.
playbook.livrable: A per-cohort impact reading and a quality correction loop.

playbook.action: Extend AI generation to new languages, markets, and deliverable types (site, application) once the cohort effect is confirmed.
playbook.livrable: Multilingual/multi-product rollout of the AI journey.

replication.equipe: A growth/product lead who owns the funnel, AI/ML engineers for the generation, cohort analysts, product designers to keep the deliverable's quality, and compliance on data use and AI transparency.

statut_vivant.note: Wix Harmony has just launched (English, January 2026) and is expanding to other languages; Base44 is in production and in strong ARR growth. Management confirmed the impact on the March 2026 earnings call. No signal of withdrawal, feature in active expansion.

transposable_ue.note: Wix already operates in the EU and Wix Harmony is available there as part of its multilingual expansion. The pattern (creation genAI embedded in the freemium funnel to raise conversion and ARPU) is a self-serve product. Points of attention in the EU: transparency about the use of AI in the editor (the AI Act's information requirement) and a GDPR legal basis for using the usage data that serves to optimize cohort conversion.
